column1: # Repository-relative test file<TAB>unique Vitest test-name pattern.
# WHY: each case below starts multiple heavyweight Ruby Wasm guests. A single
# Vitest worker retains enough Wasm/JIT backing between otherwise-correct
# host.destroy() calls to exceed a standard hosted runner's memory. Keeping the
# cases declarative lets CI exclude their file from its ordinary shards and run
# every case exactly once behind the stronger OS-process reclamation boundary.
